segments.source: Frequently Asked Questions
What is the origin of the name Nix?
The name *Nix* is derived from the Dutch word *niks*, meaning *nothing*; build actions do not see anything that has not been explicitly declared as an input.
segments.translation: *Nix*라는 이름은 *아무것도 없음*을 뜻하는 네덜란드어 단어 *niks*에서 유래했습니다. 빌드 작업은 입력으로 명시적으로 선언되지 않은 어떤 것도 볼 수 없습니다.

segments.source: — <cite>[Nix: A Safe and Policy-Free System for Software Deployment](https://edolstra.github.io/pubs/nspfssd-lisa2004-final.pdf), LISA XVIII, 2004</cite>
segments.translation: — <cite>[Nix: A Safe and Policy-Free System for Software Deployment](https://edolstra.github.io/pubs/nspfssd-lisa2004-final.pdf), LISA XVIII, 2004</cite>

segments.source: The Nix logo is inspired by [an idea for the Haskell logo](https://wiki.haskell.org/File:Sgf-logo-blue.png) and the fact that [*nix* is Latin for *snow*](https://nix-dev.science.uu.narkive.com/VDaaP1BY/nix-logo).
segments.translation: Nix 로고는 [Haskell 로고에 대한 한 아이디어](https://wiki.haskell.org/File:Sgf-logo-blue.png)와 [*nix*가 *눈*을 뜻하는 라틴어라는 사실](https://nix-dev.science.uu.narkive.com/VDaaP1BY/nix-logo)에서 영감을 받았습니다.

segments.source: What are flakes?
See [](flakes-definition).
Which channel branch should I use?
Nixpkgs and NixOS have both stable and rolling releases.
segments.translation: Nixpkgs와 NixOS는 안정 릴리스와 롤링 릴리스를 모두 제공합니다.

segments.source: These releases are distributed in variants called "channel branches": Git branches used for releases, which are also converted to Nix channels.
segments.translation: 이러한 릴리스는 "채널 브랜치"라는 변형으로 배포됩니다: 릴리스에 사용되는 Git 브랜치이며, Nix 채널로도 변환됩니다.

segments.source: Consult the [`nix-channel`](https://nix.dev/manual/nix/2.22/command-ref/nix-channel) entry in the Nix Reference Manual for more information on channels, and the [Nixpkgs contributing guide](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#branch-conventions) on the Nixpkgs branching strategy.
segments.translation: 채널에 대한 자세한 정보는 Nix 참조 매뉴얼의 [`nix-channel`](https://nix.dev/manual/nix/2.22/command-ref/nix-channel) 항목을 참고하고, Nixpkgs의 브랜치 전략에 대해서는 [Nixpkgs 기여 가이드](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#branch-conventions)를 참고하십시오.

segments.source: Stable
Stable releases receive conservative updates to fix bugs or security vulnerabilities; otherwise package versions are not changed.
segments.translation: 안정 릴리스는 버그나 보안 취약점을 수정하기 위한 보수적인 업데이트만 받으며, 그 외에는 패키지 버전이 변경되지 않습니다.

segments.source: A new stable release is made every six months.
On Linux (including NixOS and WSL), use [`nixos-*`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=nixos-).
These branches point to commits where most Linux packages got pre-built and can be fetched from the binary cache.
segments.translation: 이 브랜치들은 대부분의 Linux 패키지가 미리 빌드되어 바이너리 캐시에서 가져올 수 있는 커밋을 가리킵니다.

segments.source: Furthermore, these commits passed the full NixOS test suite.
segments.translation: 또한 이러한 커밋은 NixOS 테스트 스위트 전체를 통과했습니다.

segments.source: On macOS/Darwin, use [`nixpkgs-*-darwin`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=nixpkgs-)
These branches point to commits where most Darwin packages got pre-built and can be fetched from the binary cache.
segments.translation: 이러한 브랜치는 대부분의 Darwin 패키지가 미리 빌드되어 바이너리 캐시에서 가져올 수 있는 커밋을 가리킵니다.

segments.source: On any other platform it doesn't matter which one of the above is used.
segments.translation: 그 밖의 플랫폼에서는 위 중 어느 것을 사용해도 상관없습니다.

segments.source: Hydra doesn't pre-build any binaries for other platforms.
segments.translation: Hydra는 다른 플랫폼을 위한 바이너리를 미리 빌드하지 않습니다.

segments.source: All of these "channel branches" follow the corresponding [`release-*`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=release-) branch.
segments.translation: 이러한 "채널 브랜치"는 모두 대응하는 [`release-*`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=release-) 브랜치를 따릅니다.

segments.source: Example
`nixos-23.05` and `nixpkgs-23.05-darwin` are both based on `release-23.05`.
Rolling
Rolling releases follow [`master`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=master), the main development branch.
segments.translation: 롤링 릴리스는 주 개발 브랜치인 [`master`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=master)를 따릅니다.

segments.source: On Linux (including NixOS and WSL), use [`nixos-unstable`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=nixos-unstable).
On any other platform, use [`nixpkgs-unstable`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=nixpkgs-unstable).

[`*-small`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=-small) channel branches have passed a smaller test suite, which means they are more up-to-date with respect to their base branch, but offer fewer stability guarantees.
segments.translation: [`*-small`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/branches/all?query=-small) 채널 브랜치는 더 작은 테스트 스위트를 통과했으며, 이는 기반 브랜치에 비해 더 최신 상태임을 의미하지만 안정성 보장은 더 적습니다.

segments.source: Are there any impurities left in sandboxed builds?
segments.translation: 샌드박스 빌드에도 순수하지 않은 요소가 남아 있습니까?

segments.source: Yes.
There is:
CPU architecture—great effort is being made to avoid compilation of native instructions in favour of hardcoded supported ones.
segments.translation: CPU 아키텍처—하드코딩된 지원 명령어를 우선시하여 네이티브 명령어 컴파일을 피하기 위해 많은 노력을 기울이고 있습니다.

segments.source: System's current time/date.
The filesystem used for building (see also [`TMPDIR`](https://nix.dev/manual/nix/stable/command-ref/env-common.html#env-TMPDIR)).
Linux kernel parameters, such as:
[IPv6 capabilities](https://github.com/NixOS/nix/issues/5615).
binfmt interpreters, e.g., those configured with [`boot.binfmt.emulatedSystems`](https://search.nixos.org/options?show=boot.binfmt.emulatedSystems).
segments.translation: binfmt 인터프리터, 예를 들어 [`boot.binfmt.emulatedSystems`](https://search.nixos.org/options?show=boot.binfmt.emulatedSystems)로 설정된 것들입니다.

segments.source: Timing behaviour of the build system—a parallel Make build may not get the correct inputs in some cases.
segments.translation: 빌드 시스템의 타이밍 동작—병렬 Make 빌드는 경우에 따라 올바른 입력을 받지 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Insertion of random values, e.g., from `/dev/random` or `/dev/urandom`.
Differences between Nix versions.
For instance, a new Nix version might introduce a new environment variable.
segments.translation: 예를 들어, 새로운 Nix 버전은 새로운 환경 변수를 도입할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: A statement like `env > $out` is not promised by Nix to result in the same output, going into the future.
segments.translation: `env > $out`과 같은 구문이 앞으로도 동일한 출력을 낳을 것이라고 Nix가 보장하지는 않습니다.
